dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The question is, have you brought enough Mora?

choices.text: Uh, why are you so obsessed with Mora?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Well, first and foremost, I'm a merchant.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Second, Mora is shiny, round, and mesmerizing!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: And third, only if you truly adore Mora will it always come running your way.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: So, work hard and cherish every Mora you make.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: That way, I can stay by your side and keep earning Mora from you forever.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Well, whaddya waiting for? Get out there and chase that Mora!

choices.text: Why do you want to make so much Mora?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Because Mora is the loveliest thing in the whole world!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: And I don't want to lose anything precious to me again due to a lack of Mora... Never again...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Ahem, anyway, Mora can solve most of life's problems.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: And if you ever find a problem that Mora can't fix, just try doubling the amount you're offering!
